title: Repeat-Violation Charge Deferral by Tenure (Community Rules & Site Care Training Q&A)
content:
When a reinstatement payment is worked out under Community Rules & Site Care, the repeat-violation charges on the statement dated within the 3 calendar months ending on the handling date may be deferred by tenure alone, counted in whole calendar months from the move-in date on the Home-Site Lease to the handling date:

- with at least 120 months of tenure: 1.0 of them, that is, all of them (100%);
- with at least 60 months but fewer than 120 months: 25% of them;
- with fewer than 60 months: none.

The deferred amount is subtracted from the reinstatement balance, and what remains once every amount allowed to stay on the statement has been subtracted is never less than zero.

## Questions and answers

**Do returned payments change this deferral?** No; it turns on tenure alone.

**Which charges does the share apply to?** The repeat-violation charges dated within the 3 calendar months ending on the handling date; an older repeat-violation charge is not deferred.

**Where do the thresholds fall?** 59 months defers nothing; 60 months defers 25%; 119 months defers 25%; 120 months defers all.

**Hypothetical worked case.** Repeat-violation charges of $100.00 and $60.00 dated within the 3 months: with 130 months of tenure $160.00 is deferred; with 70 months, 25% of $160.00, which is $40.00; with 40 months, nothing.
